consumer: The frontend status panel renderer, asking 'what stamina/pain value would the GUI sidebar DISPLAY for the avatar right now?'
scope: Avatar-scoped, but the displayed/perceived view the sidebar renders, not the raw scalar
decisive_source: src/arcopolis_export.cpp::write_avatar, which writes ctx.u.get_pain()/get_stamina() raw getters straight into JSON instead of the panel's displayed (perceived) values
divergence: Avatar dosed with adrenaline or a painkiller that lowers perceived pain: raw get_pain() reports the high underlying pain while the status panel would DISPLAY a reduced perceived-pain number, so the snapshot diverges from what the GUI shows
